rv.q: Maybe Happy Ending might just be one of the best musicals I've seen in years, if not ever.
For a musical that will leave you free of any preconceptions, and that will invigorate your mind and senses ---do not miss this musical.
Overall, no manufacturer defects can be found here.
Beautifully bittersweet, Maybe Happy Ending serves as a delightful nudge to step out, venture from predictable routines, and take the leap to make a connection.

cn.t: This Tony-winning musical about robots falling in love charms critics with its bittersweet poignancy and clever exploration of what it means to be human, proving emotionally involving despite its AI premise.
